NONE: › If a criticism, insult, remark, or action is uncalled-for, it is unfair, rude, or unkind and therefore considered to be unnecessary.
（批評、侮辱、言論或行動）不公允的，不恰當的，不必要的

example: an uncalled-for remark
一句不必要的話
There's no reason to make personal comments - that was completely uncalled-for.
沒有必要進行人身攻擊——那樣做很不合適。

NONE: › strange or mysterious; difficult or impossible to explain
奇怪的；神秘的；難以（或無法）解釋的

example: an uncanny resemblance
神秘的相似性

T: › to remove the cap (= lid or cover) from something
› to make small changes to a modem (= device for connecting to the internet), especially in order to use the internet without paying a particular internet service provider
（尤指為了在上網時不向網路供應商付費而）對數據機做一些調整

example: He uncapped the bottle and poured out some rum.
他打開瓶蓋，倒出一些朗姆酒。

NONE: › not taken care of well enough
無人照料的

example: He looked unwashed and uncared for.
他看上去一副沒有梳洗、無人照料的樣子。

NONE: › not worrying about other people's troubles or doing anything to help them
冷漠的，無同情心的

example: The charity criticized the city for its "callous, uncaring attitude" to the homeless.
慈善機構批評政府對無家可歸者所採取的「冷漠無情的態度」。

NONE: › continuing and unlikely to stop or become less
持續不斷的

example: The authors are grateful for the unceasing support of the editors in London and New York.
作者們非常感激倫敦和紐約兩地編輯們的不懈支援。

NONE: › done in a rude, sudden, or informal way
粗魯的；不拘禮節的；隨意的

example: an unceremonious refusal
粗暴無禮的拒絕

NONE: B2 not knowing what to do or believe, or not able to decide about something
拿不定主意的，猶豫的
B2 not known or fixed, or not completely certain
未知的；不確定的；不完全確定的

example: [ + question word ] She's uncertain whether to go to New Zealand or not.
她對是否去紐西蘭猶豫不決。
Ariana was uncertain about meeting him.
阿麗亞娜拿不定主意是否見他。
These refugees face an uncertain future.
難民們面臨著無法預料的未來。
The political outlook is still uncertain.
政治前景仍難以預料。

NONE: C1 a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain
不確定性；不確定因素；不確定（或未知）的事物

example: Nothing is ever decided, and all the uncertainty is very bad for staff morale.
甚麽都還沒有決定，而這一切不確定因素都對員工士氣非常不利。
Life is full of uncertainties.
人生充滿了未知數。

NONE: › accepted without asking questions or criticizing
未受挑戰的；無異議的；未受批評的

example: We can't allow her comments to go unchallenged.
我們不能對她的評論聽之任之。

NONE: B2 staying the same
不變的，沒有變化的

example: The area has remained virtually unchanged in 50 years.
這個地區在50年裡基本上沒有甚麽變化。

NONE: › not typical
非典型的
› unkind and unfair
刻薄的；不寬厚的；不公平的

example: The uncharitable explanation is that she's too afraid to ask.
對此刻薄一點的解釋是她太害怕了而不敢問。

NONE: › An uncharted place or situation is completely new and therefore has never been described before.
（地方或處境）全新的，未知的，無人涉足的

example: Nuclear fusion has taken physicists into uncharted seas/territory/waters (= a new and unknown area).
核聚變將物理學家們帶入了全新的未知領域。

NONE: › If something harmful is unchecked, it is continuing or increasing without or despite any limits or attempts to prevent it.
（有害物）未受約束的，不受限制的，放任的

example: If current trends go/continue unchecked, obesity will become the number one cause of death in this country.
如果目前的趨勢得不到遏制，肥胖將成為該國最大的死亡原因。
The war raged on, unchecked by the UN's efforts to stop it.
戰火仍在蔓延，聯合國的調停努力未能奏效。

NONE: › not good, kind, or showing any care for other people; not showing the qualities expected of a Christian
違反基督教禮俗常規的；殘忍的；無仁慈心的

example: He said that it would be unchristian to refuse to help the refugees.
他說拒絕幫助難民非基督徒所為。

NONE: › not polite
不禮貌的，無禮的

example: He was most uncivil to your father - called him an old fool.
他對你父親極其無禮——稱他爲老傻瓜。
See also
incivility

NONE: › not suitable for a well developed, peaceful society where people are treated fairly
不文明的，未開化的

example: He described the punishment as "barbaric and uncivilized".
他稱這一懲罰是「野蠻和未開化的」行為。

NONE: › a very early or very late time in the day
（因為太早或太晚而）很不合適的時間

example: Sorry to call you at such an uncivilized hour.
抱歉在這麽不合適的時候給你打電話。

NONE: › If something is unclaimed, no one has said that it belongs to them or that they should have it.
無主的；物主不明的；無人領取的

example: More than €2.5 million lies unclaimed in bank accounts.
銀行帳戶裡有超過兩百五十萬歐元的無主存款。

NONE: A2 the brother of someone's mother or father, or the husband of someone's aunt or uncle
舅父；伯父；叔父；姨父；姑父
› Indian English any male adult that you know who is older than you
叔叔，大叔（任何年紀比自己大的成年男性）

example: I have lots of uncles and aunts.
我有很多叔叔、舅舅、姑姑和姨媽。
We invited my Uncle Steve over.
我們邀請了我的叔叔史蒂夫過來。
[ as form of address ] Did you bring me a present, Uncle Jack?
你給我帶禮物了嗎，傑克叔叔？
John Uncle
約翰大叔

NONE: › the US, or its government, sometimes represented by an image of a tall, thin man with a white beard and a tall hat
山姆大叔（指美國或美國政府，有時以一個留白鬚、頭戴高禮帽的瘦高個男子的形象出現，尤見於政治漫畫中）
› a black person who is considered to be too eager to agree with white people or too willing to be treated in a way that is not equal to white people
湯姆叔叔（指對白人曲意逢迎或逆來順受的黑人）
› not clean and therefore likely to cause disease
不潔淨的，骯髒的
› formal not clean or pure, or morally bad, as described by the rules of a religion
（宗教上）不潔淨的；邪惡的

example: The health risk from drinking unclean water is considerable.
喝不潔淨的水對健康的威脅相當大。
Jews and Muslims consider pigs unclean.
猶太人和穆斯林認爲豬是不潔淨的。

NONE: B2 not obvious or easy to see or know
不清楚的，含糊的
B2 If you are unclear about something, you are not certain about it.
不太明白的；不確定的

example: The ownership of the painting remains unclear.
這幅畫的歸屬目前還不清楚。
[ + question word ] It's unclear what actually happened that night.
那天晚上到底發生了甚麽尚不清楚。
It's unclear whether he arrived before or after the shot was fired.
不清楚他是在開槍之前還是之後到的。
I'm unclear about a couple of points in your proposal - could you go over them again?
我對你的提議有幾點沒弄清楚——你能不能再講一遍？
I'm unclear (as to) whether we're supposed to stay here or not.
我不清楚是否是要我們留在這兒。

NONE: B1 not feeling comfortable and pleasant, or not making you feel comfortable and pleasant
不舒服的；令人難受的
C1 slightly embarrassed, or making you feel slightly embarrassed
有點兒尷尬的；令人不自在的

example: I've eaten so much, I actually feel uncomfortable.
我吃了這麽多，實在感覺很不舒服。
These shoes are really uncomfortable.
這雙鞋子穿在腳上實在難受。
an uncomfortable silence
令人不自在的沉默

NONE: › having made no promise to support any particular group, plan, belief, or action
未表態的；未承諾的

example: 25 senators have admitted they are still uncommitted on the taxation question.
有25位參議員承認他們還未就稅收問題表明立場。

NONE: C1 not seen, happening, or experienced often
罕見的，不常有的
› old-fashioned formal An uncommon quality, especially a human quality, is larger in amount or degree than usual.
（尤指人的特質）不尋常的，異常的

example: Accidents due to failure of safety equipment are uncommon nowadays.
因安全裝置失靈導致的事故如今很罕見。
It's not uncommon for people to become ill when they travel.
人們在旅行途中患病的情況很常見。
a woman of uncommon beauty
異常漂亮的女子

NONE: › extremely
極其；極端地；異常地

example: She was uncommonly brave too.
她也異常勇敢。

NONE: › not willing to talk
不愛說話的，寡言少語的

example: He had a headache and was uncommunicative.
他頭痛，不太想說話。

NONE: › willing to do boring or difficult work without complaining or becoming angry
任勞任怨的，毫無怨言的

example: The work is boring, but he's always cheerful and uncomplaining.
這項工作很無聊，但他卻總是做得很起勁兒，毫無怨言。

NONE: › rudely criticizing
無禮批評的，貶損的

example: She had some very uncomplimentary things to say about Stephen.
關於斯蒂芬，她有一些很難聽的話要說。

NONE: › not understanding something
不理解的，迷惑的，茫然的

example: They walked through the ruins of the city with dazed, uncomprehending looks.
他們走過城市的廢墟，臉上帶著迷惘和不解。

NONE: › If people or their beliefs are uncompromising, they are fixed and do not change, especially when faced with opposition.
（尤指遭到反對時人或其信念）不妥協的，不讓步的，強硬的

example: The city council has taken an uncompromising stand against the proposals for the new building.
關於建新大樓的提案，市政委員會持強硬的反對態度。

NONE: › not worried or not interested, especially when you should be worried or interested
（尤指應當擔心或感興趣時）不擔心的，漠不關心的，無興趣的

example: The baby was apparently unconcerned by the noise.
嬰兒似乎一點兒也沒受噪音影響。
Are you as unconcerned about the situation as you seem to be?
你對局勢真的像你表現出來的那樣漠不關心嗎？

NONE: C2 complete and not limited in any way
無條件的，無限制的

example: the unconditional love that parents feel for their children
父母對自己孩子毫無保留的愛
We demand the immediate and unconditional release of all political prisoners.
我們要求立即無條件釋放所有的政治犯。

NONE: › not confident
不自信的

example: He is very unconfident about his work.
他對自己的工作非常不自信。

NONE: › If facts are unconfirmed, it is not certain if they are true.
未經確認的，未被證實的

example: According to unconfirmed reports, two people were killed in the riots last night.
根據未經證實的報道，有兩人在昨晚的騷亂中喪生。

NONE: › an interruption in the series of the earth's rock layers, resulting from either erosion (= gradual loss by the effect of weather) or the failure of layers to be created
（地表岩層的）不整合
› not connected; not related
不相關的，無關聯的

example: It's no longer possible to argue that crime is unconnected with unemployment.
不可能再認爲犯罪與失業無關了。
A series of apparently unconnected events led to his resignation.
一系列表面上並無關聯的事件導致了他的辭職。

NONE: › morally unacceptable
道德上不可接受的
› mainly UK unacceptably great in amount
（尺寸、數量或時間）過大的，過多的，過長的

example: To make people feel shame or guilt for being ill is unconscionable.
讓人們因為生病而感到羞恥和負疚是不道德的。
This unconscionable policy will cause great suffering.
這一政策在道義上令人無法接受，一定會帶來巨大的痛苦。
After waiting for an unconscionable amount of time, we were told to come back later.
在漫長的等待之後，我們被告知以後再來。

NONE: B2 in the state of not being awake, especially as the result of a head injury
（尤指因頭部受傷）昏迷的，不省人事的
C2 An unconscious thought or feeling is one that you do not know you have
（想法或感情）無意識的，潛意識的
› the part of your mind that contains feelings and thoughts that you do not know about, and that influences the way you behave
潛意識

example: She was hit on the head by a stone and knocked unconscious.
一塊石頭擊中了她的頭部，她昏了過去。
my unconscious desire to impress him
我期待吸引他注意的潛意識

NONE: › (of an action or remark) not carefully thought about
（行動或言論）欠考慮的，考慮不周的
› not allowed by the constitution (= set of rules for government) of a country or organization
違背憲法的；違反憲章的

example: Changing the law in this way would be unconstitutional.
對該法律作此改動是與憲法相抵觸的。

NONE: › too strong or violent to be controlled
無法控制的；抑制不住的

example: I suddenly had an uncontrollable desire to hit him.
我突然有一種抑制不住想打他的念頭。

NONE: C1 different from what is usual or from the way most people do things
不因循守舊的；不同尋常的

example: an unconventional childhood/lifestyle/marriage
不一樣的童年／生活方式／婚姻

NONE: › If an explanation or story is unconvincing, it does not sound or seem true or real.
（解釋或說法）似乎不真實的，不令人信服的

example: They gave some unconvincing explanations for the system failure.
關於這個系統的失靈，他們給出了一些令人難以信服的理由。
The dialogue was unconvincing, partly because it was American actors trying to speak London English.
對白聽起來不真實，部分原因在於明明是美國演員，卻非要說一口倫敦腔。

NONE: › not having been cooked
未煮過的

example: Do not store cooked and uncooked meat together.
不要把煮過的和未煮過的肉放在一起保存。

NONE: › embarrassing and not fashionable
令人尷尬的；不時髦的

example: My dad's so uncool.
我爸爸太土了。
Wearing homemade clothes was very uncool.
穿自家做的衣服看上去會覺得很土。

NONE: › not willing to work with or be helpful to other people
不願合作的，不配合的

example: I thought he was rude and uncooperative.
我發現他這人粗魯，不願與人合作。

NONE: › with different parts failing to work or move well together
不協調的；笨拙的

example: The marketing campaign was an uncoordinated effort by several different departments.
促銷活動是由幾個部門一起做的，彼此之間沒有協調好。
She was clumsy and uncoordinated as a girl.
她這個女孩笨手笨腳的，協調能力差。

NONE: › to open a bottle by pulling out its cork (= a cylinder-shaped piece of soft wood used to close it)
拔掉（瓶子）的軟木塞

example: "Who wants some wine?" asked Sally, uncorking a bottle.
莎莉打開一瓶酒，問道：「誰要喝點？」

NONE: › Uncorroborated information has not been proven to be true
（資訊）未經證實為真實的

example: She said the case against her used uncorroborated evidence.
她說針對她的案子採用了未經證實的證據。

NONE: B1 An uncountable noun is not used with "a" or "an" and cannot be made plural.
（名詞）不可數的

example: Words like "electricity", "blood", and "happiness" are uncountable.
像 electricity，blood，happiness 等詞是不可數的。
Compare
countable

NONE: › to separate two things that are joined together
使（相連的兩物）分離，使分開

example: The engine had been uncoupled from the rest of the train.
火車頭和其他部分脫鉤了。

NONE: › behaving in a rude, unpleasant way
粗魯的，不雅的，沒教養的

example: She thought he was loud-mouthed and uncouth.
她覺得他說話粗聲大氣，沒有教養。

NONE: C1 to discover something secret or hidden or remove something covering something else
揭露，發現（秘密或隱藏物）；揭開（覆蓋物）
› to find something buried under the ground by removing the earth on top of it
發掘，挖出

example: The investigation uncovered evidence of a large-scale illegal trade in wild birds.
調查發現了大規模非法交易野生鳥類的證據。
The biography is an attempt to uncover the inner man.
該傳記試圖揭示他內心世界的隱秘。
Digging in her garden, she uncovered a hoard of gold dating back to the ninth century.
在花園挖土時，她挖出了一批九世紀時埋下的金子。

NONE: › accepting something too easily, because of being unwilling or unable to criticize
不加批評的；不願批評的；無鑑別力的

example: an adoring, uncritical audience
盲目崇拜、毫無鑑別力的觀眾

NONE: › a man or woman who is considered to be the best, the most famous, or the most powerful in a particular area of life, especially when they do not have an official rank or title
無冕之王（尤指沒有官方職銜的某一領域的傑出人物）

example: Django Reinhardt, the uncrowned king of jazz guitarists
賈恩戈‧萊茵哈特，爵士吉他手中的無冕之王

NONE: › If someone is uncrushable, it is impossible to make them lose hope or confidence.
（指人）不可能使其失去希望（或自信的）
› Uncrushable cloth or clothing is designed to stay free of unwanted folds.
（人造纖維布）不起褶的，不起皺的

example: In order to succeed in life you have to have an uncrushable belief in yourself.
你必須對自己有著不可動搖的信心，才能取得人生的成功。
an uncrushable hat
不起皺的帽子

NONE: › Unctuous people or behaviour expresses too much praise, interest, friendliness, etc., in a way that is false and unpleasant.
諂媚的；虛情假意的

example: his unctuous manner/voice/smile
他那虛情假意的舉止／聲音／笑容

NONE: › complete and in its original form
未刪節的；未剪的；原封未動的

example: the original, uncut version of a film
電影未經刪節的原始版本
Uncut diamonds are worth less than those that have been cut and shaped.
未經雕琢的鑽石不如那些切割好的值錢。
